title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 81-84 (Vasundhara, Udaranga, Harini, Hemamalini)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 81 to 84: Vasundhara, Udaranga, Harini, Hemamalini, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 81 to 84 with meaning
caption: Names 81 to 84 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 81 to 84**: **Vasundhara, Udaranga, Harini, Hemamalini**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Vasundhara, Udaranga, Harini, Hemamalini.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Vasundhara** means **Earth-bearer**. Bearer of the Earth's wealth; also a name of Earth herself.
**Udaranga** means **Noble-limbed**. Noble and well formed; it also hints at a generous giver.
**Harini** means **The Golden One**. Sri Suktam: 'hiranyavarnam harinim', golden and graceful.

sections.h: Hemamalini: Wearer of a gold garland
p: **Hemamalini** means **Wearer of a gold garland**. Sri Suktam: 'suvarnam hemamalinim', wearing a garland of gold.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
